name: Tuesday Casual Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday from the Sundial Recreation Center parking lot. Start time changes by month: Jan, Feb and Dec 9:00 am. March 9:00, then 8:00. Apr, Oct and Nov 8:00 am. May and Sep 7:00 am. Jun, Jul and Aug 6:00 am. Rain cancels it.

start_location.name: Sundial Recreation Center parking lot, Sun City (northeast corner of 103rd Ave and Boswell Blvd)

pace: An average pace everyone is comfortable riding. The distance is set by who shows up.
visitor_notes: Guests are always welcome. A guest is covered by the club's insurance on the first ride only, then the club asks you to join. Everyone signs that day's waiver. A certified helmet is required, and lights are strongly encouraged. Class 2 and throttle e-bikes are not allowed. Rain at the start cancels the ride, and the club posts cancellations on its home page. The week's route, and any coffee or breakfast stop, is on the club's RideWithGPS calendar.
description: The Sun City Cycling Club's Tuesday ride, which the club calls its casual ride. The group rides at a pace everyone is comfortable with, and the distance depends on who shows up. Routes use trails, streets with bike lanes and low-traffic residential streets. Some Tuesdays include a coffee or breakfast stop. The club says beginners are welcome and the ride is no-drop.
evidence: The club's RideWithGPS calendar lists Tuesday rides for Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026 at 8:00 am, and its schedule page gives 8:00 am for October. The Sept 22 ride is listed as a normal ride. The Sept 29 entry says the ride was cancelled and breakfast still went ahead (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club's calendar feed shows the next rides with the leader's route. The schedule page holds the month-by-month start times (its Last-Modified header reads Sept 3, 2026).

name: Thursday Ride

name: Silent Sunday at South Mountain
schedule: Every Sunday the park's main road, Summit Road, closes to cars. 4th Sunday of the month: all day, 5 am to 7 pm. 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 5th Sundays: 5 am to 10 am, with the road closed at the 1.0 mile marker.

start_location.name: South Mountain Park/Preserve, Summit Road. Drivers park at the Activity Complex.

duration: Road closed 5 am to 10 am; 4th Sundays 5 am to 7 pm

host.name: City of Phoenix Parks and Recreation

visitor_notes: This is a closed road, not a led ride. The city page lists no sign-up. Vehicles must turn into the Activity Complex and park there. City staff, tower workers and emergency vehicles may be on the road at any time. Park and entrance hours are 5 a.m. to 7 p.m.
description: South Mountain's main road, Summit Road, closes to cars on Sundays and is reserved for walking, cycling, jogging and hiking. On the 4th Sunday of the month the closure lasts all day, 5 am to 7 pm. On the other Sundays it runs 5 am to 10 am and stops at the 1.0 mile marker. Riders and walkers share the road.
